[.weftext-query,version=1]
....
from tasks as task
scope workspace
where task.owner = "alice"
select task.id
order by task.id asc
limit 10
....

[.weftext-query,version=1]
....
from tasks as task
scope workspace
where task.closed = "no"
select task.id
order by task.id asc
limit 10
....

[.weftext-query,version=1]
....
from tasks as task
scope workspace
where task.priority = "urgent"
select task.id
order by task.id asc
limit 10
....

[.weftext-query,version=1]
....
from tasks as task
scope workspace
where task.title > "z"
select task.id
order by task.id asc
limit 10
....

[.weftext-query,version=1]
....
from tasks as task
scope workspace
where task.due <= date("2026-02-30")
select task.id
order by task.id asc
limit 10
....

[.weftext-query,version=1]
....
from tasks as task
scope workspace
where task.due <= context.today + P0D
select task.id
order by task.id asc
limit 10
....

[.weftext-query,version=1]
....
from nodes as node
scope workspace
where node.name is null
select node.id
order by node.id asc
limit 10
....
